title: Towards Robust Endogenous Reasoning: Unifying Drift Adaptation in Non-Stationary Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by injecting varying ratios of counterfactual reasoning tokens into text prompts during inference and measuring the degradation in decision accuracy, as well as visualizing cross-modal attention to see if the model ignores visual evidence in favor of language priors.

Using a hierarchical domain knowledge graph to synthesize controlled counterfactual visual and textual samples (perturbing specific attributes) to test whether the model's reasoning and predictions rely on genuine causal logic or confounding multi-modal correlations.
